findings.title: Cancellation-first interleavings disable the named exposure/rollback owners, while IX03 still accepts rollback IDLE
findings.requirement: Whole-work cancellation must invoke genuine rollback wherever exposure may exist, must remain total from every reachable nonterminal tuple, and must preserve one deterministic cleanup owner.
evidence: PLAN.md §8 says a cancellation request is accepted from every reachable nonterminal product tuple, reconciles effects, and invokes rollback where exposure may exist; final CANCELLED waits for genuine rollback or independently authorized remediation settlement.

Normative §15.5 says IX01 is authorized for every `ReachableNonterminalTupleV1`, but once cancellation is not NONE it rejects candidate, rollout, control, widening, and promotion edges. It permits only child stop, Effect reconciliation, safety-required rollback, quiescence closure, and cleanup.

Every relevant rollback-entry owner also changes one of those now-forbidden coordinates: IR10-X changes `CANARY_RUNNING->CANARY_ABORTING`; IH06-WX/PX changes a reconciliation rollout; IC32-RWX/RPX changes candidate/rollout; and every exposed IW/IP product row changes `WIDENING_EFFECT|PROMOTING` before creating rollback.

Concrete reachable race: from CANARY_RUNNING with a current ExposureReceipt and rollback IDLE, IX01 may win before IR10-X. After IX01, the blanket rule rejects IR10-X. Once the child stops and effects settle, IX03 accepts rollback `IDLE|ROLLED_BACK`; it does not require protected no-exposure when rollback is IDLE, so it can schedule cancellation cleanup despite proved exposure.

The same gap occurs if IX01 wins while IH01-W/P or IC32-UW/UP reconciliation is pending, or while a widening/promotion Effect is live. Effect reconciliation may settle/prove application, but the required IH06-X or exposed IW/IP/IC32-RX rollout row is forbidden. If the Effect edge can settle alone, IX03 can bypass rollback; if terminal settlement requires the synchronized product row, the tuple cannot meet IX03 and deadlocks.
findings.impact: A permitted transaction ordering can either clean up an applied canary/widening/promotion mutation without restoration or remain permanently nonterminal. This contradicts the PLAN's cancellation guarantee and the claimed complete rollback/cleanup ownership partition.
findings.required_correction: Define exact synchronized cancellation variants for protected exposure, protected no-exposure, and unsettled original Effects at CANARY_RUNNING, WIDENING_EFFECT, PROMOTING, WIDENING_RECONCILING, and PROMOTION_RECONCILING (including revoked candidates), or explicitly exempt only named safety rows from the blanket cancellation rejection. IX03 must require protected no-exposure when rollback is IDLE and require ROLLED_BACK when exposure/reversible application exists. Add IX01-first and abort/degradation/revocation/effect-response-first race witnesses and prove exact single-owner cleanup for each.
